topic: Retrieving a Card from an ATM

script.title: THE LOBBY GUARD
script.scene_zh: 銀行大廳 · 深夜詢卡
script.story_hook: A swallowed card, a late hour, a kind guard.
script.intro_zh: 晚上十點,提款機吞了卡,幸好門廳裡有位貼心的保全。
script.welcome_en: Hi! Today: a card stuck in an ATM.
script.welcome_zh: 你好!今天來學卡片卡在提款機怎麼說。
script.outro: Sixty lines — calm at the night ATM. Sleep tight!
script.outro_zh: 六十句聽完,深夜的提款機也不慌了。晚安!
script.practice_intro_en: Your turn — say each line with feeling.
script.practice_intro_zh: 換你了——帶著感情唸出每句話。
script.char_a_description: a slim college-age young man with messy blond hair under a dark beanie, an oversized denim jacket over a gray hoodie, jeans and worn sneakers, tired wide eyes, holding a dying phone
script.char_b_description: a broad-shouldered older man in his sixties with closely cropped gray hair and a bushy mustache, wearing a black security uniform with a yellow reflective stripe, a radio on his shoulder, and polished black shoes

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me — the machine ate my card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuz mi ðə məˈʃin et maɪ kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下——機器把我的卡吞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The ATM? Right here in the lobby?
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˌeɪˌtiːˈɛm raɪt hɪr ɪn ðə ˈlɑbi/
dialogue.zh: 提款機嗎?就在這門廳裡?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes. It pulled it in and froze.
dialogue.zh: 對,它把卡吞進去,然後當機了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ugh, this happens. Are you okay?
dialogue.zh: 哎,常有人碰到。你人沒事吧?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm fine. But it's ten p.m.
dialogue.zh: 我沒事,可已經是晚上十點了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Late night, alone — let's fix this.
dialogue.zh: 深夜一個人——我們來把這件事搞定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please. My phone is almost dead.
dialogue.zh: 拜託,我手機快沒電了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First: no cash came out, right?
dialogue.zh: 先確認:沒有吐出錢,對吧?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No! Nothing at all, I checked.
dialogue.zh: 沒有!我檢查過,半毛錢都沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good. That keeps it simple, friend.
dialogue.zh: 好,這樣事情就單純了,朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you open it and take out my card?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju ˈoʊpən ɪt ænd teɪk aʊt maɪ kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 你能打開機器,把我的卡拿出來嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can't — no tools, no key.
dialogue.zh: 我不行——沒有工具,也沒有鑰匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh. So what do I do now?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ soʊ wʌt du aɪ du naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 噢,那我現在該怎麼辦?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bank crew opens it each morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bæŋk kru ˈoʊpənz ɪt itʃ ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 銀行的人每天早上會打開機器。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When does the branch open, though?
dialogue.zh: 那分行幾點開門呢?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine a.m. — call before you come.
dialogue.zh: 早上九點——來之前先打電話問一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Call? Why? Is something wrong?
dialogue.zh: 打電話?怎麼了,有問題嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The screen is down — look, it's dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə skrin ɪz daʊn lʊk ɪts dɑrk/
dialogue.zh: 螢幕關了——你看,黑黑的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So my card is still in there?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ maɪ kɑrd ɪz stɪl ɪn ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 所以我的卡還留在裡面?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Probably, yes. That's okay, truly.
dialogue.zh: 應該是在,真的沒關係。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But tomorrow's my birthday…
dialogue.zh: 可是明天就是我生日了……

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Aha — is that the real worry?
dialogue.zh: 哈——真正擔心的是這個吧?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My family's at my house tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 明天我全家都要來我家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And you wanted cash for the party?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ju ˈwɑntəd kæʃ fər ðə ˈpɑrti/
dialogue.zh: 而你本來想先領現金辦派對?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! Now I look panicked, don't I?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs naʊ aɪ lʊk ˈpæŋkt doʊnt aɪ/
dialogue.zh: 對!我現在看起來很慌,是吧?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little. But we'll solve that tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl bʌt wil sɑlv ðæt təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 有一點。但我們今晚就能解決它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How? I thought you'd say 'wait.'
dialogue.zh: 怎麼辦?我以為你會叫我等明天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Groceries take cards — even offline.
dialogue.zh: 超市也能刷卡,就算離線也行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait — my card works right now?
dialogue.zh: 等等——我的卡現在還能刷?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Purchases, yes. Only cash froze.
dialogue.zh: 買東西沒問題,只有提款卡住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, thank goodness. I can shop!
dialogue.zh: 噢,謝天謝地,我還能買東西!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One store, then the bank at nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn stɔr ðɛn ðə bæŋk ət naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 先去一家店,然後九點到銀行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It didn't print my receipt, though.
dialogue.zh: 而且它連收據都沒吐出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No receipt, no record — no problem.
dialogue.zh: 沒收據,沒紀錄,也就沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So nothing was taken off my account?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈnʌθɪŋ wʌz ˈteɪkən ɔf maɪ əˈkaʊnt/
dialogue.zh: 所以我的帳戶一分錢都不會少?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing moved — it froze before that.
dialogue.zh: 錢都沒動——它在扣款前就卡住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Phew. Okay, what's your name?
dialogue.zh: 呼——總算放心了。對了,你叫什麼名字?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Frank, the friendly evening guard.
dialogue.zh: 弗蘭克,友善的夜班保全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Frank, you're the best guard ever.
dialogue.zh: 弗蘭克,你是最棒的保全!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ever? Slow down — I'm blushing now.
dialogue.zh: 最棒?別誇了,我臉都紅了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Do I need to bring ID?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ du aɪ nid tə brɪŋ ˌaɪˈdi/
dialogue.zh: 哈!我明天要帶身份證嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and know your account number.
dialogue.zh: 要,還有記得你的帳號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's in my app — lucky me.
dialogue.zh: 我手機軟體裡就有——算我幸運。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect — they'll hand it right back.
dialogue.zh: 完美——他們會直接還給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hand it back? Not a new card?
dialogue.phonetic: /hænd ɪt bæk nɑt ə nu kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 直接還我舊卡?不用換新卡嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old card, new start, same number.
dialogue.zh: 舊卡重新啟用,帳號一模一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That saves me a week, seriously.
dialogue.zh: 那真的幫我省下一週的時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now, a small favor for me?
dialogue.zh: 那,可以幫我一個小忙嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, of course. What is it?
dialogue.zh: 當然可以,你說吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: When you get it back, tell them hi.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛn ju ɡɛt ɪt bæk tɛl ðɛm haɪ/
dialogue.zh: 拿到卡的時候,在銀行幫我打個招呼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal. I'll tell them Frank said hi.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil aɪl tɛl ðɛm fræŋk sɛd haɪ/
dialogue.zh: 成交,我會說弗蘭克問好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ride the bus home — it takes cards.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪd ðə bʌs hoʊm ɪt teɪks kɑrdz/
dialogue.zh: 坐公車回家吧——公車也能刷卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will. You've been so kind.
dialogue.zh: 我會的,你人真的太好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Part of the job. We shut at ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɑrt əv ðə dʒɑb wi ʃʌt ət tɛn/
dialogue.zh: 分內的事。我們十點關門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right. Well… will you be here at nine?
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt wɛl wɪl ju bi hɪr ət naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 好。那……你九點還會在嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nights only. Dave takes over.
dialogue.zh: 我只有夜班,戴夫會接手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Nine sharp, then. Thanks, Frank!
dialogue.zh: 哈!那我九點整到。謝謝你,弗蘭克!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine sharp. Happy early birthday!
dialogue.zh: 九點整,提前祝你生日快樂!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're a star. Goodnight, lobby hero!
dialogue.zh: 你真是大好人,晚安,門廳英雄!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Goodnight! Watch your phone battery.
dialogue.zh: 晚安!留意你的手機電量。
